articles.title: IndyCar Makes History on D.C.'s Iconic Streets
articles.summary: The nation's capital hosted its first IndyCar street race, the Freedom 250. Florida's Kyle Kirkwood dominated, leading 128 of 147 laps. Thousands cheered as a bald eagle soared overhead.

articles.title: Climate Change: The 'Other Big One' Is Coming
articles.summary: Scientists warn that climate change is making extreme weather more frequent and intense. From Australia's Black Summer to Pakistan's floods, the evidence is mounting. But will we act in time?

articles.title: Japan's Delegation Aims to Defrost China Relations
articles.summary: Japanese lawmakers visited Beijing to ease tensions over Taiwan comments. The rift has disrupted trade and communication. A former diplomat called it the worst since 1972.
